text:
maria_sales: Hey team — urgent POC ask from Acero (enterprise). Need a dedicated GPU pool for a demo next Tue. Requirements:
- Region: us-west2
- Preferred SKU: H100 80GB (model: gpt-large-h100-70b)
- Expected steady-state QPS: ~25 requests/sec
- Avg prompt + response: ~120 tokens
- Target 99th latency: <300ms
- Burst headroom for spikes: +2 nodes
Also need VPC peering + private API key for their eng team. Can we get capacity estimate and rough cost? Any blockers for Tue demo? :eyes:
text_extra:
rafael_se: quick q — are requests short-running (single shot) or streaming? That affects batching and node sizing.

maria_sales: single-shot text gen, no streaming. hoping we can keep batch sizes small to meet latency.

cheng_infra: rough calc: H100 80GB can handle ~130-250 concurrent small inferences depending on batching. For <300ms 99p at 25 QPS, I would provision 4 x H100 as baseline with autoscale to 6 for bursts. That matches your +2 headroom.

emily_pm: timeline constraint — provisioning needs approval from finance for reserved hours or we do on-demand. Which does Acero prefer? Reserved = lower unit cost but needs commit.

maria_sales: prefer reserved for cost predictability but they might not commit before PoC. Start on-demand and discuss reserved if they convert.

rafael_se: cost ballpark (on-demand): H100-80GB node ~ $12/hr (infra estimate) — 4 nodes = ~$48/hr baseline. Add networking and support margin ~ +15%. If they want 24/7 test window for 2 weeks, estimate ~$1.7k. (this is rough)

alex_t: security note — dedicated pools still sit in our cloud account. For VPC peering + private API keys we need their CIDR + contact. Also if they require customer-managed KMS/HSM for keys we need legal + sec signoff, could add ~3 business days.

maria_sales: they asked about audit logs retention and access controls. Is that available out of the box?

cheng_infra: yes — we can enable request/response logs to GCS/S3 and set retention. Default retention is 30d; we can extend but S3 costs apply. We'll need the destination bucket IAM details.

deploy-bot: Pool provisioning request created: #req-5467. ETA: 48-72 hrs after infra approval.

emily_pm: blockers checklist:
- Finance approval for on-demand card (maria)
- Customer CIDR + peering contact (maria)
- Security questionnaire answers for KMS/logging (securing)
- SE to validate model performance on sample prompts (rafael)

rafael_se: I'll run a micro-benchmark on gpt-large-h100-70b using their sample prompts. If perf deviates we'll propose 6 nodes or quantized variant.

maria_sales: I'll get CIDR + confirm billing tonight. Can infra provision a placeholder pool (4xH100) without peering so we can validate model perf, then add VPC peering later?

cheng_infra: yes — we can spin up without peering. Note: private API keys + peering require a short maintenance window to attach routing rules. Plan for 1hr work.

maria_sales: perfect. Please track dependencies in the req ticket. Thanks all :thumbsup:
notes: Contains short, actionable Slack-style messages; includes deploy-bot automated line and a small cost estimate.
